questions.question: Which workspace in Zurich eliminates silos between service and operations teams for faster alert resolution?

explanation.correct: Service Operations Workspace eliminates silos between service and operations teams and delivers an intuitive, streamlined experience for faster alert resolution. Key features include an insightful landing page, live alert list, noise reduction through correlation, and quick access to related records. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/itom-articles/quick-start-guide-for-itom-aiops-event-management/ta-p/3406132

Event Management Console is not the Zurich workspace name.
Alert Center Workspace is not the correct name for this feature.

references: Quick Start Guide for ITOM AIOps Event Management

source.excerpt: Service Operations Workspace eliminates silos between service & operations teams for faster alert resolution.

questions.question: What Service Operations Workspace feature provides a single pane of glass for alert triaging, analysis, and investigation?

explanation.correct: The Live Alert List in Service Operations Workspace serves as a single pane of glass for alert triaging, analysis, and investigation. It provides noise reduction through alert correlation which groups related alerts together. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/itom-articles/quick-start-guide-for-itom-aiops-event-management/ta-p/3406132

questions.question: Which component in Zurich's Service Operations Workspace is used by monitoring teams to manage incoming alerts?
